metadata.title: Res Nova: Geometrically Ordered Dynamics and Information Tension — Dual-Channel Action, Covariant Completion, and Formal Verification
metadata.description: The dual-channel action F_dual(x) = ½x² - x + ln(1+x) has constitutive ratio F'(x)/x equal to the MOND interpolation function μ(x) = x/(1+x). Given four structural constraints — constitutive-relation form, Padé[1/1] minimality, the MOND boundary conditions, and dual-channel splitting — F_dual is uniquely determined; the necessity of the Padé constraint is not derived, so the uniqueness is conditional. Embedded in the Skordis-Złośnik (2021) RMOND framework, the linear screening ratio F''/F' ≈ 0.004 reduces a 76× structure overproduction to 0.4% in linear growth, and Vainshtein screening places the solar-system quadrupole at Q₂ ≈ 4.9×10⁻²⁹ s⁻², a factor 70 below the Cassini bound at natural O(1) couplings. Ghost-free with c_T = c. 21 Lean 4 modules verified, no sorry, axioms restricted to {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}, including exact Cartan Triality fermion generation count (N_gen = 3) and Ramanujan-Chladni nodal harmonic mass hierarchy. SPARC 175-galaxy benchmark; a₀ = (1.116 ± 0.016)×10⁻¹⁰ m/s². A pre-registered a₀(z) test favours constant a₀ over the horizon-tied a₀(z) = ξcH(z) at 5.9σ. A pre-registered, fail-closed N-body test of the cosmological sector (D5) is included in this version: gevolution (particle-mesh, 256³ particles, 200 Mpc/h box, seed 42) patched so that G_eff(a,k) multiplies the Poisson kernel (Hassani & Lombriser 2020), run as a two-arm campaign (α=1 theory; α=0.01 negative control) against a ΛCDM baseline with identical initial conditions, under a hash-frozen pre-registration. The pipeline-sensitivity gate passes: the negative control shows a +22.2% median power enhancement at low k (linear prediction +20.4%). The theory arm (α=1) yields an INCONCLUSIVE verdict — nonlinear amplification reaches 3.0% (worst bin, k = 1.35 h/Mpc, z = 1), above the 1% consistency bound but below the 5% tension threshold — so the cosmological target D5 remains open with a measured ΔP/P table. No manuscript claim rests on this result. The negative-control gate also detected and refused to certify a build defect (MG patch compiled out) before publication, demonstrating the falsification apparatus. Raw particle snapshots are excluded from the deposit (bit-regenerable from seed 42 and the frozen parameters); power spectra, logs, verdicts, and all analysis code are included.
